# Trustless Voting SaaS - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
A cryptographically secure, tamper-proof voting system for government elections.

## Core Principles
- Zero-trust architecture
- End-to-end verifiability
- Voter anonymity with accountability
- Tamper-proof audit trails
- No single point of failure

## Tech Stack
- Backend: Node.js + TypeScript + Express
- Frontend: React + TypeScript + Vite
- Database: PostgreSQL + Prisma
- Cryptography: libsodium (sodium-native)
- Storage: IPFS for immutable ledger
- Consensus: Custom BFT consensus

## Security Requirements
- All votes must be encrypted end-to-end
- Zero-knowledge proofs for voter eligibility
- Homomorphic encryption for tallying
- Cryptographic signatures for all actions
- Immutable audit trail
- Public verifiability without compromising privacy
